    //==
    // # Residuals
    //
    // The distance from one sample to the fitted shape.

    // The perpendicular distance from a sample to the fitted line.
    Residual(self: LineFit2D, sample: Point2D): Number
        => self.Line.DistanceTo(sample);

    // The perpendicular distance from a sample to the fitted line.
    Residual(self: LineFit3D, sample: Point3D): Number
        => self.Line.DistanceTo(sample);

    // The unsigned perpendicular distance from a sample to the fitted plane.
    Residual(self: PlaneFit3D, sample: Point3D): Number
        => self.Plane.SignedDistance(sample).Abs;

    // The radial residual: how far the sample's distance from the centre
    // departs from the fitted radius.
    Residual(self: CircleFit2D, sample: Point2D): Number
        => (sample.Distance(self.Circle.Center) - self.Circle.Radius).Abs;

    // The radial residual of a sample against the fitted sphere.
    Residual(self: SphereFit3D, sample: Point3D): Number
        => (sample.Distance(self.Sphere.Center) - self.Sphere.Radius).Abs;

    //==
    // # Which side
    //
    // The signed reading of a residual, where the shape separates two regions.

    // True when the sample lies on the fitted plane's front side, the side its
    // normal points into.
    IsInFront(self: PlaneFit3D, sample: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Plane.SignedDistance(sample) > 0.0;

    // True when the sample lies inside the fitted circle.
    Contains(self: CircleFit2D, sample: Point2D): Boolean
        => sample.Distance(self.Circle.Center) < self.Circle.Radius;

    // True when the sample lies inside the fitted sphere.
    Contains(self: SphereFit3D, sample: Point3D): Boolean
        => sample.Distance(self.Sphere.Center) < self.Sphere.Radius;

    //==
    // # Convex hull readings
    //
    // The counts, degeneracy tests, and provenance lookups of the hull records in
    // `geometry.types.plato`, plus the 2D constructor. The 3D hull remains
    // read-only: instances arrive from a host until a quickhull lands (see
    // tracker/decisions/2026-08-04-spatial-structure-construction-in-plato.md).

    //==
    // # 2D hulls

    // The number of vertices on the hull boundary.
    HullVertexCount(self: ConvexHull2D): Integer
        => self.Hull.Points.Count;

    // The source point a hull vertex came from. Precondition: vertex is a
    // valid position in the hull boundary.
    SourceOf(self: ConvexHull2D, vertex: Integer): ItemIndex
        => self.SourceIndices[vertex];

    // The hull vertices as the source points they came from, in hull order.
    // The provenance the hull preserves: index a per-point attribute array
    // with these to carry attributes onto the hull.
    SourcePoints(self: ConvexHull2D, points: Array<Point2D>): Array<Point2D>
        => self.SourceIndices.Map(i => points[i.Value]);

    // True when the hull has no area: fewer than three vertices, which is what
    // an empty, single-point, or collinear input produces.
    IsDegenerate(self: ConvexHull2D): Boolean
        => self.HullVertexCount < 3;

    // The convex hull of a point set, by the monotone-chain sweep
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Convex_hull_algorithms): sort the points
    // lexicographically, then grow the lower and the upper chain, popping every
    // corner that fails to turn left. O(n log n) in the sort, O(n) after it.
    // Collinear boundary points are dropped — every emitted corner turns
    // strictly left — so the hull is the minimal vertex set, wound
    // counter-clockwise as CONVENTIONS.md requires. Inputs with fewer than
    // three points, or without three non-collinear ones, yield a degenerate
    // record (IsDegenerate) carrying the surviving chain.
    ConvexHull(points: Array<Point2D>): ConvexHull2D
    {
        var n = points.Count;
        if (n <= 2)
        {
            return (Polygon2D(points), n.MapRange(i => ItemIndex(i)));
        }
        var order = points.SortedIndices((a, b) => a.X < b.X || (a.X == b.X && a.Y <= b.Y));
        var chain = new Buffer<Integer>(n + n);
        var k = 0;
        var i = 0;
        while (i < n)
        {
            var lowerPoint = points[order[i]];
            var popping = true;
            // The nesting is load-bearing: `&&` is `And`, an ordinary function
            // of two evaluated arguments, so it does not short-circuit — a
            // combined guard would read chain slots that do not exist yet.
            while (popping)
            {
                if (k < 2) { popping = false; }
                else if (TwiceSignedArea(points[chain.At(k - 2)], points[chain.At(k - 1)], lowerPoint) <= 0.0) { k = k - 1; }
                else { popping = false; }
            }
            chain = chain.Set(k, order[i]);
            k = k + 1;
            i = i + 1;
        }
        // The upper chain may pop down to, but never through, the completed
        // lower chain plus its own first point.
        var floor = k + 1;
        i = n - 2;
        while (i >= 0)
        {
            var upperPoint = points[order[i]];
            var popping = true;
            while (popping)
            {
                if (k < floor) { popping = false; }
                else if (TwiceSignedArea(points[chain.At(k - 2)], points[chain.At(k - 1)], upperPoint) <= 0.0) { k = k - 1; }
                else { popping = false; }
            }
            chain = chain.Set(k, order[i]);
            k = k + 1;
            i = i - 1;
        }
        // The final slot repeats the first vertex; drop it.
        var m = k - 1;
        return (Polygon2D(m.MapRange(j => points[chain.At(j)])),
            m.MapRange(j => ItemIndex(chain.At(j))));
    }

    //==
    // # 3D hulls

    // The number of vertices on the hull surface.
    HullVertexCount(self: ConvexHull3D): Integer
        => self.Hull.Positions.Count;

    // The number of triangles on the hull surface.
    HullFaceCount(self: ConvexHull3D): Integer
        => self.Hull.Faces.Count;

    // The source point a hull vertex came from. Precondition: vertex is a
    // valid position in the hull's vertex array.
    SourceOf(self: ConvexHull3D, vertex: Integer): ItemIndex
        => self.SourceIndices[vertex];

    // The hull vertices as the source points they came from, in hull vertex
    // order.
    SourcePoints(self: ConvexHull3D, points: Array<Point3D>): Array<Point3D>
        => self.SourceIndices.Map(i => points[i.Value]);
